m0-context.title: Load baseline context and verify handoff
m0-context.imperative: Read CREW_CONTEXT.md, handoff, key reference files (car_prior.py, sim_evaluator.py, physics_simulator.py, capability_envelope.py). Confirm handoff complete.

postconditions.statement: crew context + handoff loaded; handoff complete (task/intent/scope/exclusions/evidence/test-mode/stop conditions all present)

m0-context.finding: Handoff complete. Key seams understood: CarCeilingResult.params/.envelope from car_prior.py; resample_by_progress + BRAKING_DECEL_THRESHOLD from sim_evaluator.py; PhysicsSimulator.simulate_lap + _sample_parameters from physics_simulator.py. NOTE: monte_carlo_laps returns LapTimeDistribution (lap times only, NOT per-point speed profiles). Will implement per-point MC speed profiling by calling _sample_parameters+simulate_lap in a loop (same pattern, canonical path). The utilization package exists at src/physics/utilization/.

m1-red.title: TDD red phase: write failing tests
m1-red.imperative: Write tests/unit/physics/test_regime_utilization.py with ALL required test cases. Run pytest — expect import errors or assertion failures (red). Tests must cover: (1) frontier U_r~1.0, (2) uniform-0.9 U_r~0.9, (3) partition tiling (four masks cover every point exactly once), (4) covariance monotonic (inflating cov increases sigma_U), (5) slow vs fast corner classification from a_lat threshold.

postconditions.statement: pytest test_regime_utilization.py fails with import error (module not yet written)

constraints: no FastF1 or DB in tests

m2-green.title: TDD green phase: implement regime_utilization.py
m2-green.imperative: Write src/physics/utilization/regime_utilization.py. Pure core: regime_utilization(distance, curvature, v_real, v_ideal, *, config) -> RegimeUtilization with four tiling masks (braking/slow_corner/fast_corner/straight), U_r = regime-mean(v_real/v_ideal) clipped, consistency = 1-CV. Thin wrapper: estimate_driver_utilization(ceiling: CarCeilingResult, track_df, driver_distance, driver_speed, *, sim, n_mc_samples) using PhysicsSimulator for ideal lap and _sample_parameters loop for MC speed profiles. Run pytest until green.

preconditions.statement: test file exists and is red

m3-simplification.title: Simplification limits check
m3-simplification.imperative: Run py -m src.utils.simplification_limits --paths src/physics/utilization/regime_utilization.py tests/unit/physics/test_regime_utilization.py and fix any violations (CC>=20, func>=100 lines, file>=1000 lines).
